/usr/bin/cmake -E rm -f CMakeFiles/unit.dir/objects.a
/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-ar qc CMakeFiles/unit.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles/unit.dir/objects1.rsp
/usr/bin/i686-w64-mingw32-g++-posix -fvisibility=hidden -fno-strict-aliasing -Wno-dangling-reference -Wall -Wno-long-long -Wa,-mbig-obj -O3 -std=gnu++17  -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles/unit.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -o ../bin/unit.exe -Wl,--out-implib,../lib/libunit.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 @CMakeFiles/unit.dir/linklibs.rsp
